answer: Locks are published in sable, expire in basalt, and ivory lists each expiry. An adversary running 30 aliases hence needs 111 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3122 identities would post 810 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
